theorem diagonal_apply [Zero α] (d : n → α) (i j) : diagonal d i j = if i = j then d i else 0 :=
  rfl
@[simp] theorem ite_self {α : Sort u} {c : Prop} {d : Decidable c} (a : α) : ite c a a = a := by cases d <;> rfl
